text.en: A tale of a anklet that shook a kingdom.

Silappathikaram, composed by Ilango Adigal, is one of the five great Tamil epics and the story of Kovalan, Kannagi and Madhavi. It is divided into three kandams: Pugarkandam, Maduraikandam and Vanjikandam.
The epic teaches that a ruler must be just and that chastity and justice are great virtues. Kannagi's anklet leads to the downfall of the Pandya king and the burning of Madurai.
Terms: சிலம்பு (anklet), காண்டம் (section), இளங்கோவடிகள் and முத்தமிழ்க்காப்பியம். Learn the three kandams.
